note: Design settled after 001-007: single tile, reactive skip-and-remember companion servicing (no dedicated wood investment -- wood accumulates for free from ordinary companion churn once a standing Bush/Tree matures, unlocking Carrot around cycle ~15-25). Measured steady-state throughput ~49.9 hay/tick, projecting ~330s (05:30) to 100,000,000 -- ~2.4x off the leader's 02:17.995, but a real, measured improvement over earlier ~3x/~7:00 estimates. Multi-tile is closed (schedulability floor is 1 tile; useful clustering distances self-collide; safe distances pay a commute tax that outweighs any benefit). 008 builds the real terminating driver from 007's exact logic and runs it for an actual score. See experiments/hay_single/00{1..7}/result.md and queue.md.
